newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - March 5.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - March 5.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

Building products manufacturer and energy group said its half year net profit fell 45 percent to A$93.16 million and cut its interim dividend to 7.5 cents from 10.5 cents in the previous corresponding half. The company said it anticipated a stronger second half result.

The property group said on Tuesday it would hold a news conference in Sydney at 12.30 p.m (0130 GMT) today to make an important announcement about its U.S. operations. Westfield owns 49.1 percent of Westfield America Trust.
Melbourne-based brokerage, J.B. Were and Son rated Australia's largest company as a long term buy but said the group's near term outlook was clouded by forecasts for lower copper and oil prices.
Petroleum group said its 1996 year net profit rose to A$19.52 million from A$13.13 million in calendar 1995.
These companies expected to announce results today.
